newsitem.title: CANADA: Placer says Highlands must secure financing by Fri.
newsitem.headline: Placer says Highlands must secure financing by Fri.

text.p: Gold miner Placer Dome Inc confirmed on Monday that it reached agreement with Highlands Gold Ltd on a restructuring but said the deal was contingent on Highlands' securing a financing commitment for A$160 million by Friday.
Earlier in Sydney, Highlands said Placer had agreed to the deal, which would entail Placer paying A$316.1 million for Highlands' 25 percent interest in the Porgera gold mine in Papua New Guinea.

Highlands instead proposed to sell its stake in the Porgera mine to Placer and spin off the rest of its assets into a new company. It said the restructuring would offer shareholders substantially higher value.
